text_to_image_prompt:
生成一张完整的场景设定图板，画幅 1168×1347。六格两列三行公寓场景图。西雅图天际线与太空针塔出现在北窗外；从入户门看客厅、狭窄厨房、沙发反打、夜间卧室、玄关走廊、日出北窗。灰白哑光墙、低饱和雾蓝沙发、鼠尾草绿厨柜、浅旧橡木地板、棉麻与适量绿植。柔和自然窗光，夜景保留蓝色环境光和少量台灯；真实空间透视、细腻材质、英文面板标签，无人物。
纯环境，不出现人物、动物、鸟、鱼、手部或角色倒影。沙发为空；街道、车站、笼子和水域无任何角色；屏幕不显示人像，装饰画采用植物或抽象图案。
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is the attached scene board. Remove the sleeping cat on the sofa in panel three and any other animal or character-like pictures throughout. Reconstruct the sofa cushion and blanket naturally. Replace the small cat illustration poster with a plain abstract botanical print. Preserve all six panels, architecture, furniture layout, materials, camera angles, time of day, panel borders and existing labels. Final image is strictly environment only: no human or animal anywhere, including pictures, screens, mirrors and distant corners. Do not introduce new objects or redesign the spaces.
